additional_info.subject: ID0459031-DC/Si-D/NL-[Y2 / S9 313873507001] Quarter-Hour Data & MID Meters CRM:03055000254
additional_info.body:
Hello Luuk, good afternoon. Hope you are doing well today.
It seems that this charger is not equipped with a AC or DC meter. As such, it's not possible to provide the information you require.
From OCPP it should be possible to calculate these values from the Energy.Active.Import.Interval, since the Energy.Active.Import.Register cannot be sent due to the missing meters.
Let me know if this answered to your questions and can close the ticket.
Thanks and have a nice day!
Best regards,
Francisco
